message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin together. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain unreachable. With those bypass conditions unavailable, mfa:dbadmin blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI-server secrets route open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration; segmentation alone can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation or laptop; and any single patch or mfa:user leaves an alternative attack route available."}
